hero.lede: Independent practitioner working from our Sans Souci Doctors premises. Developmental & General Paediatrician. Consulting in English, Burmese.

paragraphs: Dr Moe Moe Thinn is a Developmental and General Paediatrician (ABN: 97 891 685 726) (MED0001187561) consulting at the Sans Souci Centre. She is one of the very few paediatricians in Australia with dual specialities recognition in Community Child Health and General Paediatrics.

Dr Moe Moe completed her medical degree and Postgraduate Diploma in Child Health through the University of New South Wales (UNSW), later earning a Master of Public Health from Monash University. She has accumulated over a decade of extensive clinical experience in paediatrics, practicing across diverse metropolitan and rural hospital networks within the Sydney Children’s Hospital Network.
Driven by a deep passion for promoting the long-term wellbeing of children and their families, her clinical expertise centers on managing complex developmental and behavioural conditions.

Alongside her clinical practice, Dr Moe Moe is actively involved in medical education and research. She has served as a Conjoint Lecturer at UNSW Medicine and holds an appointment as an Honorary Senior Lecturer at the University of Wollongong, where she regularly teaches and examines medical students. She remains deeply committed to ongoing academic research and international charity work.
